system-characteristics.description: A serverless AWS system that assesses itself daily against the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Moderate baseline, records the results as OSCAL with hash-verified evidence, and answers control questions through an AI chat that can only cite that evidence.

information-types.title: Internal records (synthetic test data)
information-types.description: Records created through the records API. Synthetic data only; no PII, PHI, or CUI.

authorization-boundary.description: One AWS account in us-east-1. Inside: the records API (API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3), the logging and encryption foundation (CloudTrail, CloudWatch Logs, KMS), the evidence plane (Config, Security Hub CSPM, the evidence pipeline, evidence bucket, status table, AWS Backup), and the chat plane (chat Lambda, Bedrock, Cognito, chat API, CloudFront and the web bucket). Outside: AWS itself (leveraged provider), administrator workstations, and GitHub.

components.title: Self-Audited System
components.description: All resources defined in this repository's Terraform.

components.title: Amazon Web Services (leveraged)
components.description: Cloud service provider. Physical, environmental, and media protections are inherited.

components.title: AWS Security Hub CSPM (NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 standard)
components.description: Automated control checks. Findings are the primary automated assessment input.

control-implementation.description: Implementation of the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Moderate baseline. Status is assessed daily; see oscal/samples and the evidence bucket for current results.
